The quickflow of an interval (ex. a month) of the InVEST Seasonal Water Yield model, from the precipitation, the curve number and the number of rain events.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** SCS, Runoff, CN, Quickflow, Hydrology, Hydromorphology<br>
**Authors:** The klab team.<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.SWYQuickflow`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRainfall` | raster file | mm |  | The map of the precipitation of the interval. |
| `inNet` | raster file |  |  | The map of the stream network. |
| `inCurveNumber` | raster file |  |  | The map of the curve number, which encapsulates soil, land cover and antecedent moisture. |
| `inNumberOfEvents` | raster file |  |  | The map of the number of rain events of the interval (if not set, or novalue, 10). |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outQuickflow` | output file | mm | The map of the quickflow of the interval. |

**References**

- Natural Capital Project. InVEST User's Guide, Seasonal Water Yield. Stanford University, University of Minnesota, Chinese Academy of Sciences, The Nature Conservancy, World Wildlife Fund, Stockholm Resilience Centre and the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences. https://releases.naturalcapitalproject.org/invest-userguide/latest/
- Hamel, P., Valencia, J., Schmitt, R., Shrestha, M., Piman, T., Sharp, R. P., Francesconi, W., Guswa, A. J. (2020). Modeling seasonal water yield for landscape management: Applications in Peru and Myanmar. Journal of Environmental Management, 270, 110792.
